description: Aggregated Smart Metering Data is a dataset listed in Northern Powergrid open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by Northern Powergrid. Our Aggregated Smart Metering Dataset provides half-hourly recordings of real and reactive power usage by smart meters in our licence areas where we are currently collecting this data. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Network. Its keywords are Low Voltage (LV), Methodology. The portal shows 2025-09-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Northern Powergrid Open Data Licence v1.0 (https://northernpowergrid.opendatasoft.com/p/opendatalicence/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-npg-open-data-portal.
